1 Business Development Manager (m/f/d) - Partnership & Growth (Mid-Level) Tasks
As a Business Development Manager - Partnerships & Growth at Trinsik, you drive partner acquisition for a global leading digital loyalty platform. Your core mission is targeting, reaching out to, and securing high-value brands to bring valuable offers into our loyalty ecosystem.

You manage the outreach pipeline end-to-end - from initial contact to signed partnership - and are measured on conversion. Our job is to build groundbreaking rewards platforms. Your job is to bring top-tier brand partners on board.

What You'll Do
º Own B2B partner and customer acquisition end-to-end for client projects - from target identification to closed deal

º Understand the value proposition of new or existing products fast, and translate it into sharp, conversion-focused outreach

º Build and manage the pipeline: prospecting, outreach sequencing, follow-up, qualification and closing

º Track, report and optimize the funnel - response rates, conversion, pipeline health - and react to the data

º Represent our clients' ventures and brands credibly to partners and decision-makers, often at senior level

º Test, learn and iterate on messaging, channels and targeting to lift conversion

Requirements
º A proven track record in (B2B) outreach, business development, sales or partnerships - you've built pipeline and closed deals

º The ability to understand a new offering fast and articulate its value convincingly

º A sales-, conversion- and success-driven mindset: you measure yourself on outcomes, not activity

º End-to-end ownership: comfortable running the full acquisition process independently, with structure and discipline

º Excellent communication and negotiation skills, written and verbal, in German and English

º Confident with CRM / pipeline tools and a data-informed approach to tracking and optimization

º A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
º Experience in high-profile brand acquisition or strategic partnerships

º Background in venture building, startups, or agency/consulting environments

º Familiarity with AI tools for outreach, research and pipeline automation

Benefits
The Numbers: €50,000 - €60,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible working hours and home office to balance your life, while keeping a vibrant team dynamic in our offices.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere within the EU (up to 20 calendar days/year) or take advantage of our sabbatical options.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: A well-established, experienced crew located in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears-whether it's about designs, business ideas, or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

In a nutshell
Position: Full Time 

Entry Level: Mid-Level

Location: Vienna

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to get a clear picture of who you are - and to give you a clear picture of us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

1st Stage
Chemistry Check & Initial Technical Exchange: 30 min, virtual, with Maria (Head of People)

2nd Stage
Technical Skills: 60min in person, with two of our colleagues

3rd Stage
30 min virtual with Manuel (Partner)

The goal is to make Walls.io the primary source AI engines actually cite for social media feeds, social APIs, UGC, and event marketing. You'll create E-E-A-T-driven content to build our brand presence and topical authority across LLMs and track our brand's share of voice.

Search and AI visibility don't stop at our own site. Where it moves the needle, you can build presence on platforms that shape both organic discovery and how LLMs perceive us: YouTube as a search engine in its own right and Reddit or LinkedIn strategies that feed brand authority and GEO. You decide which channels are worth the effort.

Run GEO growth experiments

Every month, you'll propose, launch, and test a mini project outside your day-to-day: a new channel, content format, tool, or tactic, with success criteria defined upfront and measured throughout.

Manage SEO

Your day-to-day work covers a wide range of SEO topics, from discovering new search terms and building links to updating existing content and conducting regular technical SEO audits.

Automate

You automate before you're asked to. Audits, keyword research, competitor tracking, and reporting run on scripts, AI agents, or workflows you built, not manual pulls from GSC, Ahrefs, or PostHog every week.

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, you've set baselines and launched your first experiments. Over the following quarter, qualified signups and demo requests from organic channels are trending clearly upward, our LLM share of voice is climbing against competitors, and your core reporting and audits run automatically instead of by hand.

Who you are

 * Experience: minimum 4 years of experience in SEO, preferably within SaaS. You understand how LLM-generated answers work.
 * Proven track record: Experience in increasing organic traffic and generating business for a SaaS product.
 * Skills: Strong communication skills. Exceptional written and spoken English. Technical background so you can read HTML/CSS/JS, reason about crawlability, publish mini websites independently, and write technical specs for developers when needed.
 * You use AI every day. You've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT way beyond the chatbox. You already automate tasks like reporting, data analysis, audits, and content creation, focusing on outstanding results, no slop.
 * Initiative is at the heart of this role. You must proactively identify opportunities or challenges and take action to address them without waiting for direction. We're looking for a test-and-learn mindset.

Our offer
You will work in a centrally located office with a lot of natural light and space in a renovated factory building. There's a fully equipped kitchen with big dining tables, sound-proofed phone/video call booths, meeting and focus rooms, and a relaxation area.

 * A collaborative and supportive international team that values open communication and teamwork.

 * Free public transport card for Vienna's excellent network
 * Fun team activities
 * An inclusive work environment that fosters professional growth and development
 * Full access to paid AI tooling: Claude, ChatGPT, whatever you need
 * Company 100% owned by the original founder

Additional Information

 * Position: Full-time (38.5 hours/week) based in Vienna.
